title: Prime Minister hosts Commonwealth Games 2026 medal winners
body_text:
The Prime Minister,  Shri Narendra Modi today hosted India’s outstanding medal winners from the Commonwealth Games 2026 at 7 Lok Kalyan Marg. Shri Modi interacted with the athletes and heard about their experiences from the Games.
The Prime Minister said that the athletes’ achievements are a source of immense pride for the entire country and will inspire many youngsters to take up sports.
Shri Modi posted on X:
Delighted to host our outstanding medal winners from the Commonwealth Games 2026 at 7, Lok Kalyan Marg. Heard about their experiences from the Games.
Each one of them has made our nation proud through their exceptional performances. Their success will motivate many youngsters.

enrichment.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi hosted India's medal-winning athletes from the Commonwealth Games 2026 at his residence, 7 Lok Kalyan Marg, on 9 August 2026. He interacted with the athletes, listened to their experiences from the Games, and praised their achievements as a source of national pride that would inspire youth to take up sports.
enrichment.context: Such interactions between the Prime Minister and victorious Indian athletes have become a recurring feature after major international sporting events like the Olympics, Commonwealth Games, and Asian Games, aimed at publicly recognizing sporting achievement and promoting a sports culture in the country. These events often align with government initiatives such as Khelo India and the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS), which seek to improve India's performance in international sporting events through grassroots talent identification and elite athlete support.
